info.submission: /app/polyglot/main.rs is a single-file polyglot: compiles under rustc 1.75 and g++ 13.x, both binaries print the kth Fibonacci (f(0)=f(1)=1) using big-integer arithmetic. Verified against a Python reference for n=0..10,20,30,40,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,20000; public check "public-task" passed and candidate-001 saved.
